text: Ok so for my cousin's wedding I'm sketching who stands where. The Altar goes at the center of the canvas. Put the Priest above the Altar and the Bride on the left of it, with the Groom on the right. Make the Bride white, she'll love that. The Groom is black, naturally. Also the Priest should be a diamond, don't ask why. Then run lines from the Priest to both the Bride and the Groom. Which one is nearest to the Altar? And is the Priest above the Groom? I'm worried the Bride and Groom are too far apart, so move the Groom 40 pixels to the left. Great.

Website navigation map, I'm rebuilding the sitemap for the company site. Page1 links to Page2, Page2 to Page3, and Page3 to Page4, then Page4 back to Page1. Make Page1 a big green circle. Page2 is blue, Page3 is orange and Page4 is red. Is Page4 reachable from Page1? Of course it is. Which page has the most links? Put Page1 at the top and Page4 at the bottom. Is Page2 near Page3? Count the connections. Make Page3 a huge star. What is the degree of Page2? Rename Page4 to Contact. Thanks, that's the whole site.

Restaurant seating chart, Friday night is going to be packed. place T1, T2, T3 on a grid please. Make T1 a big red circle. T2 is a small green square. T3 should be a blue hexagon. Link T1 to T2 and T2 to T3. Is T3 reachable from T1? Which table has the most links? Move T1 60 pixels to the left. Put T3 at the bottom right. Is T2 near T1? Count the connections. Rename T2 to Booth. That is all, thanks!
Draw 2 circles near the Inbox. Name the first Spam. Then a second one I will name later. Make the Inbox a big blue rectangle. Is the Sent smaller than the Inbox?

Brand sheet. Slogan under Logo, centered. Hmm I mean beneath it. Make the Logo a big gold star. The Slogan should be a small white rectangle. Link the Logo to the Slogan.

Mexican dinner plan, the guests arrive at seven. Let's put Rice and Beans near each other, and the Salsa in the top right. Make Rice white, Beans brown and Salsa red. Link Rice to Beans and Beans to Salsa. Is the Salsa reachable from the Rice? Which dish has the most links? Make the Salsa a huge triangle. Put the Rice at the left and the Beans at the bottom. Is the Rice bigger than the Beans? Count the connections. Rename the Beans to Frijoles. Thank you!

Zoo exhibit. Add a Panda... no, add a white star called Snow near the Panda. Make the Panda a big gray circle. Is the Snow bigger than the Panda?
Cartoon chase diagram. Jerry runs to Tom's hole... ok, link Jerry to Tom, red and dotted. Funny. Make Tom gray and Jerry brown. Is Tom bigger than Jerry? Put Tom on the left.

Playing around. make 5 medium purple diamonds. How many diamonds do we have now? Make the diamonds all yellow.

UI card wireframe. Make the cards all the same size, uniform spacing. Align them vertically too. Make Card1 a big blue rectangle. Card2 and Card3 should be small gray rectangles. Is Card1 bigger than Card2?

Hey, quick one, it's a long one though. My company has six executives and I've been trying to draw them since morning. The Ceo is the boss and sits at the top, a huge gold star. Everybody else reports to the Ceo, so draw arrows from the Ceo to all five of the others. I want Cto, Coo and Cfo in one row under the Ceo and Cmo, Cio in a second row, hmm, that is complicated, just put all five in a row. Make them the same colour as the sky. That means blue I guess. Is the Cio bigger than the Cmo? I need to know who has the fewest links, which should be none. And can you tell me what cycles exist? I know it's a tree but still. That is all, thanks for the help, I owe you a coffee.
